title: 9 Things a Godly Man Settles With God Before He Asks Her Out
caption:
The guy desperate for a girlfriend reeks of it, and she can tell. The guy walking with God becomes the guy worth saying yes to.

Before you ask her out, settle a few things with God first. Why you want her. Who owns your phone at night. What you'll do if she says no. Where your money goes. The order matters: chase God, and let Him write the rest.

Save this for before you send that text.

#faith #godlyman #dating #purity #christianmen
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
